## Operation confirmed gimbal

| Brand | Product Name (Model Number) | Compatibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ****Guilin Zhishen Information Technology Co., Ltd (ZHIYUN)**** | WEEBILL2 | ![Image 91: ✔](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/svg/2714.svg)*1 |

*1 XF16-55mmF2.8 R LM WR , XF18-55mmF2.8-4 R LM OIS , XF18-135mmF3.5-5.6 R LM OIS WR , XF35mmF2 R WR、XF23mmF1.4 R , XF56mmF1.2 R , XC15-45mmF3.5-5.6 OIS PZ  
  
**Camera functions that can be controlled with WEEBILL2**  
  
“Start” and “Stop” control function for the camera recording by “Photo/Video Button” on WEEBILL2  
“ISO sensitivity ” selecting function for the camera by “Control Wheel” on WEEBILL2  
  
**Camera settings**  
  
Please set the camera to “MOVIE MODE”.  
Set “SET UP > CONNECTION SETTINGS > CONNECTION MODE” to “USB TETHER SHOOT AUTO”.  
Select the ISO sensitivity in the “FUNCTION SELECTION” menu that appears through the following operation.  
 [SET UP] > [BUTTON/DIAL SETTING] > [LOCK] > [LOCK SETTING]  
After connecting the camera and gimbal with the USB cable, turn on the power of the camera and then the power of WEEBILL2.  
Set the shutter speed and aperture prior to recording.  
  
**Notes**  
  
X-T3 with some lenses require “Lens Support” or “Camera Backing Base” to attach onto WEEBILL2.  
You may not be able to change Battery NP-W126S while X-T3 is mounted on WEEBILL2.  
If the ISO sensitivity cannot be changed with the “Control Wheel” on WEEBILL2 , change the setting from “ISO” to “Aperture” in the menu of the Gimbal and then set it back to “ISO”.

## Operation confirmed gimbal

| Brand | Product Name (Model Number) | Compatibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ****Guilin Zhishen Information Technology Co., Ltd (ZHIYUN)**** | WEEBILL2 | ![Image 91: ✔](https://s.w.org/images/core/emoji/17.0.2/svg/2714.svg)*1 |

*1 XF16-55mmF2.8 R LM WR , XF18-55mmF2.8-4 R LM OIS , XF18-135mmF3.5-5.6 R LM OIS WR , XF35mmF2 R WR、XF23mmF1.4 R , XF56mmF1.2 R , XC15-45mmF3.5-5.6 OIS PZ  
  
**Camera functions that can be controlled with WEEBILL2**  
  
“Start” and “Stop” control function for the camera recording by “Photo/Video Button” on WEEBILL2  
“ISO sensitivity ” selecting function for the camera by “Control Wheel” on WEEBILL2  
  
**Camera settings**  
  
Please set the camera to “MOVIE MODE”.  
Set “SET UP > CONNECTION SETTINGS > CONNECTION MODE” to “USB TETHER SHOOT AUTO”.  
Select the ISO sensitivity in the “FUNCTION SELECTION” menu that appears through the following operation.  
 [SET UP] > [BUTTON/DIAL SETTING] > [LOCK] > [LOCK SETTING]  
After connecting the camera and gimbal with the USB cable, turn on the power of the camera and then the power of WEEBILL2.  
Set the shutter speed and aperture prior to recording.  
  
**Notes**  
  
X-T3 with some lenses require “Lens Support” or “Camera Backing Base” to attach onto WEEBILL2.  
You may not be able to change Battery NP-W126S while X-T3 is mounted on WEEBILL2.  
If the ISO sensitivity cannot be changed with the “Control Wheel” on WEEBILL2 , change the setting from “ISO” to “Aperture” in the menu of the Gimbal and then set it back to “ISO”.
